question: Do feature-conditioned GRU and causal TCN improve near-flutter optimism and matched-budget unstable misses, alone or added to the frozen existing spatial MLP blend?
scope: 77 original TRAIN designs, 4454 physical clips, original five design folds, seeds 42/43/44, all 37 existing acquisition conditions. Reserved selection/calibration/test designs and production defaults untouched. Exploratory repeated TRAIN evaluation, not blind confirmation.
data: Original selected16 sensors, causal 51-sample calibration, cap50, 512 acquired samples. Stop at the first selected-channel cap; unavailable prefixes use one zero sample. No poles, velocities, solver truth, labels or design identity in inputs. Same measured174 modal/spatial features plus log(reported dt); all numerical scaling fitted on fit designs only. Original four training views clean/iid1_seed928/iid5_seed928/iid1_seed929, equal weights.

models.gru: One unidirectional GRU layer, hidden64, early/late/last prefix summaries. No recurrent dropout no-op.
models.tcn: Width32, eight residual two-convolution causal blocks, kernel3, dilations1..128, per-timestep channel LayerNorm, dropout0.1, receptive field1021 covers512. Early/late/last prefix summaries.

head: 175 standardized measured features ->32 ReLU; concatenate temporal summary ->32 ReLU/dropout0.1 -> ordered q05/q50/q95. Initial interval half-width0.1. No hyperparameter/architecture sweep.

optimization.objective: pinball weights2/1/1; sample-weighted validation; restore best validation epoch
optimization.selection: Within each fit partition, seed2047+outerfold+innerpart shuffles unique designs; ceil20% for selection. Selection is separate from combiner query, outer calibration and held designs. After selecting epoch count, refit from the same seed on every fit design for exactly that count; selection features are never used to scale the selection fit.

fusion: Each model independently: standalone; fixed50/50 with frozen blend; frozen blend plus normalized-ridge residual correction on seven frozen control readouts plus temporal-minus-blend. Three inner design folds seed1047+outerfold, historical one/full base pair predictions replayed. Compare learned addition against matched blend-only correction. LAMBDA0.1, unpenalized intercept, fit-only scaling. No temporal model is trained on inner query or calibration designs. No joint GRU+TCN addition or post-result tuning.
calibration: Original outer proper/calibration/held design partitions. Original four calibration views only, common residual-derived90% raw and design-maximum bands, residual-RMS Gaussian probability comparator, calibration-selected1/5/10/20% stable false-warning budgets. Standalone native quantiles also saved, but common residual bands are the fair primary comparison. Frozen blend predictions and thresholds must replay exactly.
evaluation: Complete held populations, both fresh draws in independent/correlated1/5% families, seed/fold stability. Paired2000 whole-design bootstrap preserving all seeds/acquisition pairs; no refit uncertainty or multiplicity correction. Primary: unstable-last1% optimism>0.03 and warning misses at5% calibrated false-warning budget. Guardrails: stable-last1% errors, clean accuracy, far-stable underestimation>0.05, actual held stable false warnings. Aggregate MAE secondary. Report uncertainty, intervals and all original conditions. No deployment adoption or warning certification based on exploratory intervals.
